title: Gaitan cord
summary: Plait a cord of five woollen strands, red, white and black, taking each outer strand over two others in turn, as the cord-makers of Bulgarian villages do for coats and costumes.
howToPlay: Five strands hang below the braid.
The pair that crosses next is outlined: tap the strand that goes over.
Keep plaiting until the cord is finished, then press Check.
rules: The outer strand goes over two strands, first from the right, then from the left.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40.
Doing nothing scores nothing. Watch and learn plays a whole round for you.
heritageNote: Gaitan is a plaited woollen cord made in Bulgaria. It is used to trim the dark woollen coats of the region, and the plaiter takes each outer strand over its neighbours in a fixed rhythm.
